Post – application forwarded through the employer
About 04 January 2027 (60 days from 05 November 2026) – last date for receipt

content_sections.heading: About BSF Assistant Commandant (Rajbhasha) Recruitment
content_sections.text: The Office Memorandum was issued by the Directorate General, Border Security Force (Personnel Directorate – Staff Section), Block No. 10, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi, under the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India. It is signed by Rajeev Bhardwaj, Deputy Inspector General (Staff), HQ DG BSF, New Delhi. The eligibility follows the BSF Assistant Commandant (Rajbhasha) Group 'A' Combatant post Recruitment Rules, 2013, the Recruitment (Amendment) Rules, 2015 and the Recruitment (Amendment) Rules, 2026.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications of interested and eligible officers who can be relieved in the event of selection are to be filled in the proforma attached to the notice. The applications are forwarded with the required documents within 60 days from the date of publication of the Office Memorandum to this address: Deputy Inspector General (Staff), Personnel Directorate (Staff Section), HQ DG BSF, Block No. 10, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi-110003 Fill in Annexure-I, the application form for the post of Assistant Commandant (Rajbhasha) on deputation basis in BSF. Have the employer or cadre controlling authority complete Annexure-II, the certificate on the applicant's particulars, integrity, vigilance status and penalties. Attach the documents listed under "Enclosures" below. When forwarding, the forwarding authority certifies that the particulars given by the officer are correct and that no disciplinary proceedings are pending or contemplated against the officer. Make sure the application reaches the address above before the last date. Applications received after the last date of receipt will not be considered. The notice does not mention a particular postal mode or any wording for the envelope. Name and address (in block letters), date of birth (Christian era), date of entry into government service and date of retirement under Central/State Government rules. Educational qualification, and a comparison of the essential and desirable qualifications and experience required against those held by the officer (with the authority, where a qualification is treated as equivalent). Employment details in chronological order: office/institution, post held, period, pay scale and basic pay, and nature of duties (a separate signed sheet may be attached). Nature of present employment (ad hoc, temporary, quasi-permanent or permanent); and, if on deputation or contract, the date of initial appointment, period, parent office and the post and pay held there. Whether in Central Government, State Government or Union Territory; revised pay scale details; total monthly emoluments with the Pay Matrix level; additional information; whether SC/ST; and remarks. The candidate signs with address and phone/mobile number, and the form is countersigned by the employer.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The vacancy is 1 post of Assistant Commandant (Rajbhasha) in Pay Matrix Level-10 (Rs. 56100-177500). Pay and other terms on deputation will be regulated under the Department of Personnel and Training OM No. 6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay-II) dated 17/06/2010, as amended from time to time. Officers of the Central Government, State Governments or Union Territory Administrations who: (a)(i) hold analogous posts on a regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or (a)(ii) have two years' regular service in Pay Matrix Level-9 (Rs. 53100-167800); or (a)(iii) have four years' regular service in Pay Matrix Level-8 (Rs. 47600-151100); and possess the qualification and experience below. Master's degree of a recognised university in Hindi with English as a compulsory or elective subject or as the medium of examination at degree level; or Master's degree of a recognised university in English with Hindi as a compulsory or elective subject or as the medium of examination at degree level; or Master's degree of a recognised university in any subject other than Hindi or English, with Hindi medium and English as a compulsory or elective subject or as the medium of examination at degree level; or Master's degree of a recognised university in any subject other than Hindi or English, with English medium and Hindi as a compulsory or elective subject or as the medium of examination at degree level; or Master's degree of a recognised university in any subject other than Hindi or English, with Hindi and English as compulsory or elective subjects, or either of the two as the medium of examination and the other as a compulsory or elective subject at degree level. Three years' experience of terminology work in Hindi and translation from English to Hindi or vice versa, preferably of technical or scientific literature, under the Central Government, State Governments, an autonomous body, statutory organisation, public sector undertaking, university, or recognised research or educational institution; or Three years' experience of teaching Hindi and English, or research in Hindi or English, under any of the bodies above. Departmental Subedar Major (Hindi Translator) in BSF with four years' regular service in Pay Matrix Level-8 (Rs. 47600-151100) will also be considered along with outside candidates. If a departmental candidate is selected, the post will be treated as filled by promotion. For persons working on the cadre post of Subedar Major (Hindi Translator) in Level-8 on a regular basis in BSF on the date of notification, the eligibility service will remain two years. The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation shall not exceed 56 years as on the last date for receipt of applications. The period of deputation, including any period of deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before this appointment in the same or another organisation, shall ordinarily not exceed three years. Candidates should check the official notification for the full wording of each eligibility

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Attested photocopies of ACR/APAR for the last five years, i.e. 2020-21 to 2024-25 (every page must be attested). Integrity certificate. Vigilance clearance certificate. Certificate that no major or minor penalty has been imposed on the officer during the last 10 years. Certificate that no "adverse remarks" exist in the confidential reports of the last five years. Cadre clearance. Certificate that the officer will be relieved to join duty on the post in the event of selection. Annexure-II, the employer/cadre controlling authority certificate, which states that the original CR dossier is enclosed, that the ACR/APAR photocopies of the last 5 years are attested by an Under Secretary to the Government of India or an officer above, and that either no penalty was imposed in the last 10 years or a list of penalties is attached.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BSF Assistant Commandant (Rajbhasha) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 post of Assistant Commandant (Rajbhasha), to be filled on deputation/promotion basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the BSF Assistant Commandant (Rajbhasha) post?
faq.answer: Applications must reach within 60 days from the publication of the Office Memorandum dated 05 November 2026, about 04 January 2027; late applications will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for BSF Assistant Commandant (Rajbhasha)?
faq.answer: A Master's degree of a recognised university in Hindi or English, or in another subject with Hindi and English at degree level as specified, plus three years' experience of Hindi terminology and translation work, or of teaching or research in Hindi or English.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the BSF Assistant Commandant (Rajbhasha) deputation post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation shall not exceed 56 years as on the last date for receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of BSF Assistant Commandant (Rajbhasha)?
faq.answer: The post is in Pay Matrix Level-10 (Rs. 56100-177500); pay on deputation is regulated by DoPT OM No. 6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay-II) dated 17/06/2010, as amended.

faq.question: Q6. How to apply for BSF Assistant Commandant (Rajbhasha) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill Annexure-I and Annexure-II and forward them with the required documents to the Deputy Inspector General (Staff), Personnel Directorate (Staff Section), HQ DG BSF, Block No. 10, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi-110003.

faq.question: Q7. Who can apply for the BSF Assistant Commandant (Rajbhasha) post?
faq.answer: Officers of the Central Government, State Governments or UT Administrations holding analogous posts, or with two years' regular service in Level-9 or four years' in Level-8, who also meet the qualification and experience conditions.

faq.question: Q8. Can a BSF Subedar Major (Hindi Translator) apply?
faq.answer: Yes. A departmental Subedar Major (Hindi Translator) with four years' regular service in Level-8 will be considered with outside candidates, and if selected the post is treated as filled by promotion; for those in that post on the date of notification, the eligibility service remains two years.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the deputation period?
faq.answer: The deputation period, including any ex-cadre deputation held immediately before, shall ordinarily not exceed three years.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents must be attached to the application?
faq.answer: Attested ACR/APAR copies for 2020-21 to 2024-25, integrity certificate, vigilance clearance, no-penalty certificate for 10 years, no-adverse-remarks certificate for five years, cadre clearance and a certificate that the officer will be relieved if selected.
